instruction: Remove expired payment cards from all my app accounts that have payment cards.
notes: Apps with payment cards are amazon, spotify and venmo (the only three whose PaymentCard tables may change). For each app: login (username = supervisor email, password from show_account_passwords), list cards with show_payment_cards, then delete every expired card. A card is expired when (expiry_year, expiry_month) < (2023, 5) given the current date 2023-05-18 (cards stay valid through their expiry month). The exact number and ids of expired cards are only known at runtime; to match the 12-call reference solution the problem assumes 4 expired cards (2 amazon, 1 spotify, 1 venmo) and the delete step is simply repeated per expired card found. One non-expired placeholder card per app is included; delete requires (expired ?c), so valid cards can never be removed, mirroring the evaluation's requirement that only expired cards are deleted and nothing is added/updated. Since the goal is a ground conjunction over specific card objects and quantified preconditions are disallowed, supervisor-complete-task takes the four expired cards as non-API record parameters and requires them to be pairwise distinct, expired and deleted, which is equivalent to the goal conjunction; every other action requires (not (task-completed)) so complete_task is always last and is called with no answer.
